name: List All Community Associations
description: Returns all Community Associations that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the Community Association

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter Community Associations by last updated date. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the Community Association

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name of the Community Association

responseFields.name: data[].Address1
responseFields.description: The primary address of the Community Association

responseFields.name: data[].Address2
responseFields.description: The secondary address of the Community Association

responseFields.name: data[].City
responseFields.description: The city where the Community Association is located

responseFields.name: data[].State
responseFields.description: The state where the Community Association is located

responseFields.name: data[].Zip
responseFields.description: The zip code where the Community Association is located

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the Community Association's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].CustomFields
responseFields.description: The custom fields for the associated entity
